comment: The language toggle's ONE predicate (integrations listmonk/NAMING-STANDARD-SPEC D2, I12): toggle '' (All) matches everything; a language matches campaigns in that language AND every campaign with no language (lang null = attribs without the key; '' = an empty value). Read by frontend/src/naming.test.mjs (naming.mjs::langMatches) and by cmd/campaigns_test.go (the query-campaigns lang predicate) -- change both together.
